title: Record return
purpose: Record that a specimen sent in a shipment came back to the repository.
summary: Record that a specimen sent in a shipment came back to the repository.

tasks.title: Record the return
steps: Type the [[Amount returned]] exactly as measured, and the [[Thaws reported while away]] if known.
Choose [[Received by (custodian)]], enter [[Returned at]] and the [[Reason]], then select [[Record return]].

tasks.title: Store it
steps: Open the specimen and select Record check-in.

good_to_know: The specimen comes back on a use hold until a manager reviews the return.
Left empty, thaws are recorded as not known, never as zero.
Enter 0 when nothing is left. The specimen becomes Exhausted.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Technicians, managers and administrators, for an item of a dispatched shipment that has not already been returned. It opens in the form dialog over the page you came from; without JavaScript it is a page of its own. Cancel returns without saving.

items.label: Amount returned
items.description: Required, in the specimen's unit (shown beside the field) as an exact decimal; 0 when nothing is left. The text you enter is kept.

items.label: Thaws reported while away
items.description: Optional whole number as the recipient reported it. Left empty, it is recorded as not known.

items.label: Condition
items.description: Optional, as found on return. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Received by (custodian)
items.description: Required: the operating staff member who holds it until it is checked in; you by default.

items.label: Returned at
items.description: Required; repository local time, not before dispatch and not in the future.

items.label: Attachment
items.description: Optional: PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV, up to 10 MiB. Do not upload consent forms, signatures or any document that identifies a participant.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, kept in the specimen's history. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: What happens
paragraphs: The specimen comes back into the custody of the person receiving it, with the measured amount and the reported thaws; it becomes available (or exhausted when nothing is left) and gets a use hold referring to the shipment until a manager reviews it. Store it afterwards with the specimen's Check in. If someone changed the record after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay in the form and the next save uses the current version.
